title: Kanda 20: Hymns of Healing & Cosmic Harmony
summary: Sacred prayers of Shaunaka Shakha from Kanda 20.
ai_summary: Vedic hymns of health, protection, and universal peace from Kanda 20.

verses.original: इन्द्रस्य नु वीर्याणि प्र वोचं यानि चकार प्रथमानि वज्री । अहन्नहिमन्वपस्ततर्द प्र वक्षणा अभिनत्पर्वतानाम् ॥
verses.transliteration: indrasya nu vīryāṇi pra vocaṁ yāni cakāra prathamāni vajrī | ahannahimanvapastatarda pra vakṣaṇā abhinatparvatānām ||
verses.translation: Now I proclaim the triumphant deeds of Indra, the thunderbolt-wielder: he slew the dragon of drought, he released the waters, he cleft the channels of the mountains!

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: The final triumphal hymn celebrating the victory of light, rain, and life over stagnation and drought.

layers.author: whitney
layers.content: सायण भाष्य: Now I proclaim the triumphant deeds of Indra, the thunderbolt-wielder: he slew the dragon of drought, he released the waters, he cleft the channels of the mountains!

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: अथर्ववेद काण्ड 20: The final triumphal hymn celebrating the victory of light, rain, and life over stagnation and drought.
